subject: English
passage: One of the few female architects to gain international recognition during the early 20th century, ______
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: 1902 and 1951 were the years between which Julia Morgan designed more than 700 buildings.
choices.B: California was where Julia Morgan designed more than 700 buildings between 1902 and 1951.
choices.C: Julia Morgan designed more than 700 buildings between 1902 and 1951.
choices.D: more than 700 buildings were designed by Julia Morgan between 1902 and 1951.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-modifier placement. This choice makes the proper noun "Julia Morgan" the subject of the sentence and places it immediately after the modifying phrase "one…century." In doing so, this choice clearly establishes that Julia Morgan—and not another noun in the sentence—is being described as one of the few female architects to gain international recognition during the early 20th century.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because it results in a dangling modifier. The placement of the noun phrase "more than 700 buildings" immediately after the modifying phrase illogically suggests that the buildings were one of the few female architects to gain international recognition during the early 20th century.
